Item Combinator 1.5.0 for Minecraft Java Edition 1.21.1 (Fabric)

What you need: Minecraft Java Edition 1.21.1, Fabric Loader 0.15.11 or newer, and Fabric API for 1.21.1.
How to install: put item-combinator-1.5.0.jar and the Fabric API .jar into the "mods" folder.

Make a backup of your world first. Many items of this mod destroy or change large parts of the world for good.

New in 1.5.0: 23 items, and 5 new worlds

Other worlds
- Pocket Dimension Cube: your own furnished room in the Pocket Dimension. Sneak to take everything within 4 blocks along.
- Noclip Pearl: into the Backrooms, endless yellow rooms with flickering lamps and Smilers. Sneak + right-click throws it:
  a mob or player it hits comes along.
- Cloud Key: the Sky Realm, floating islands. Fall off and you drop back into your own world.
- Moon Rocket: the Moon, with craters, meteorites and a sixth of the gravity. There is no air: wear an Oxygen Helmet.
- Looking Glass: the Other Side, an untouched copy of your world's land, at eternal dusk.
- Dimension Hopper: jumps through every world, those of other mods too.
- Banishing Wand: sends a mob to the Backrooms.

Teleportation: Wormhole Gun, Grave Compass, Escape Rope, Elevator Pearl, Friendship Bracelet, Wanderlust Atlas, Pet Whistle.
Creation: Architect's Blueprint (real game structures), Biome Brush, Builder's Wand, Express Rail Wand.
Utility: Quarry in a Box, Sorting Wand, Ender Mail, Lumen Orb, Almond Water.

Changed: the Diving Helmet is now the Oxygen Helmet, with a new look. It and the Spelunker's Helmet give air on the Moon.

Known limits: the five new worlds were tested in new worlds only. Texts are in English only.
